title: Modified genomic DNA extraction method for Heterosigma akashiwo
author: Monica Accerbi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.himb4c6
materials: Combine homogenate in two 15 ml tubes
Air dry the DNA pellet and dissolve it in 200 µl Qiagen elution buffer Expected yield 25-30 µg

steps.title: Prepare and centrifuge culture
steps.instruction: Divide 2 x 100 ml of axenic Heterosigma akashiwo culture (approx. 2.5 x 10^5 cells/ml) into 50 ml round bottom tubes and centrifuge in a swing rotor at 2,000 rpm for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare DNA Extraction Buffer with the following final concentrations in DNase/RNase-free water: 2% (w/v) CTAB, 100 mM Tris Buffer (pH 8.0), 20 mM EDTA, 1.4 M NaCl, and 1% (w/v) PVP (MW 40,000).

substeps.instruction: Stir CTAB-containing buffers overnight to ensure complete dissolution.
Add 2% (v/v) β-mercaptoethanol to the required amount of buffer immediately before use.

steps.title: Initial buffer addition and homogenization
steps.instruction: Pour off the liquid from the centrifuged tubes and add 2 ml of DNA Extraction Buffer per tube.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize the pellet using a PT3100 Polytron at max speed for 10–15 seconds to disrupt the cells.

steps.title: Further buffer addition and incubation
steps.instruction: Add 8 ml of DNA Extraction Buffer to each tube and incubate at 65°C for 1 hour.

substeps.instruction: Mix by gentle inversion; do not vortex.
Gently mix the tubes every 10 minutes during incubation.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add RNase A to a final concentration of 100 µg/ml and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Clarification of lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 13,000 rpm at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: First phenol-chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube and extract with an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (IAA) (25:24:1, pH 6.6).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 2 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: High Salt Buffer treatment
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous upper phase to a new tube and add 1/10 volume of pre-warmed (65°C) High Salt Buffer (10% w/v CTAB and 0.7 M NaCl in DNase/RNase-free water).

steps.title: Second phenol-chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the mixture with the same volume of phenol:chloroform:IAA as used in the first extraction.

steps.title: Chloroform-IAA extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous upper phase and extract with an equal volume of chloroform:IAA (24:1).

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous upper phase into a new tube and add 0.8 volume of isopropanol and 40 µg of glycoblue.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm at 4°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pellet washing
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet twice with 70% (v/v) ethanol.
